mainEntity.name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO for contractor websites?

acceptedAnswer.text: While traditional SEO focuses on ranking your website high in search results to drive clicks, AEO is about optimizing your content to provide direct, concise answers to user queries, often appearing in 'featured snippets,' 'People Also Ask' sections, or voice search results. AEO emphasizes clarity, conciseness, and structured data to ensure search engines can easily extract and present your information as a direct answer. Traditional SEO prioritizes organic visibility, whereas AEO aims for immediate, direct answers, which is crucial for users seeking quick solutions or local services.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO focuses on providing direct answers in search results, often for voice or featured snippets, by optimizing content for clarity and structured data. Traditional SEO aims for high website rankings and clicks.
